Name: DICOM Controlled Terminology Definitions
Description: DICOM Code Definitions (Coding Scheme Designator "DCM" Coding Scheme Version "01")

Name: RetinaCautionCodeSystem
Title: Retina Cautions
Description: Cautions to consider when grading examinations (5000-series).

Name: RetinaConclusionCodeSystem
Title: Retina Conclusion
Description: Codes for the current or final conclusion of the grading process (1000-series).

Name: RetinaImageQualityCodeSystem
Title: Retina Image Quality
Description: Image quality as assessed by AI solution (2000-series).

Name: RetinaImageViewCodeSystem
Title: Retina Image View
Description: Codes describing the centering used when capturing retinal images (6000-series).

Name: DeviceNameType
Title: DeviceNameType
Description: The type of name the device is referred by.

Name: FHIRDeviceStatus
Title: FHIRDeviceStatus
Description: The availability status of the device.

Name: DiagnosticReportStatus
Title: DiagnosticReportStatus
Description: The status of the diagnostic report.

Name: IdentifierUse
Title: IdentifierUse
Description: Identifies the purpose for this identifier, if known .

Name: ImagingStudyStatus
Title: ImagingStudyStatus
Description: The status of the ImagingStudy.

Name: ObservationStatus
Title: ObservationStatus
Description: Codes providing the status of an observation.

Name: UDIEntryType
Title: UDIEntryType
Description: Codes to identify how UDI data was entered.

Name: SNOMED_CT
Title: SNOMED CT (all versions)
Description: SNOMED CT is the most comprehensive and precise clinical health terminology product in the world, owned and distributed around the world by The International Health Terminology Standards Development Organisation (IHTSDO).

Name: DataAbsentReason
Title: DataAbsentReason
Description: Used to specify why the normally expected content of the data element is missing.

Name: FHIRDeviceStatusReason
Title: FHIRDeviceStatusReason
Description: The availability status reason of the device.

Name: ObservationCategoryCodes
Title: Observation Category Codes
Description: Observation Category codes.

Name: ObservationReferenceRangeMeaningCodes
Title: Observation Reference Range Meaning Codes
Description: This value set defines a set of codes that can be used to indicate the meaning/use of a reference range for a particular target population.

Name: DiagnosticServiceSectionId
Title: diagnosticServiceSectionId
Description: HL7-defined code system of concepts which specify a section of a diagnostic service where the observation may be performed.  Used in HL7 Version 2.x messaging in the OBR and OM4 segments.

Name: IdentifierType
Title: identifierType
Description: HL7-defined code system of concepts specifying type of identifier. Used in HL7 Version 2.x messaging data types CX, PLN, PPN, XCN and XON.

Name: ObservationInterpretation
Title: ObservationInterpretation
Description: One or more codes providing a rough qualitative interpretation of the observation, such as "normal" / "abnormal", "low" / "high", "better" / "worse", "resistant" / "susceptible", "expected" / "not expected". The value set is intended to be for ANY use where coded representation of an interpretation is needed.

Name: ParticipationType
Title: ParticipationType
Description: A code specifying the meaning and purpose of every Participation instance. Each of its values implies specific constraints on the Roles undertaking the participation.
